# spec/emit/helpers

`spec/emit/helpers` — the Nish helpers an emitted test may define. Each is
spelled for one type, since Nish has no generics, and a test defines only
the ones it uses, in the order `emitHelperNames` gives.

Generated from [src/spec/emit/helpers.ts](https://github.com/amritk/vector/blob/main/src/spec/emit/helpers.ts).

## Exports

- [`emitHelperNames`](#emithelpernames)
- [`emitHelperDeps`](#emithelperdeps)
- [`emitHelperText`](#emithelpertext)

## Declarations

### emitHelperNames

Every helper a test can define, in the order a test defines them.
`unwrapStr` is not a helper of its own: it adds `str` to `Unwrap`.

```ts
function emitHelperNames(): string[]
```

<scalar-field name="returns" type="string[]">

the helper names

</scalar-field>

### emitHelperDeps

The helpers a helper calls, which a test using it must define too.

```ts
function emitHelperDeps(name: string): string[]
```

<scalar-field name="name" type="string" required>

a helper name

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="string[]">

the helpers it needs

</scalar-field>

### emitHelperText

A helper's definition, as the emitted test spells it.

```ts
function emitHelperText(name: string, withStr: boolean): string
```

<scalar-field name="name" type="string" required>

a helper from emitHelperNames, but not `unwrapStr`

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="withStr" type="boolean" required>

for `Unwrap`, whether to add its `str` method

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="string">

the definition, or "" for an unknown name

</scalar-field>
